count_contours — 2D features op

• Data kinds: contour → feature

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "count_contours", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: count_obj (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

輪郭（オブジェクト）の本数を返す特徴量。HALCON の `count_obj`（Number of objects in a tuple.）に相当。

`a, b` は未使用。輪郭リストの長さをそのまま返すだけ。
